events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on this day in 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Impact
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago today, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music. What's your favourite track from the album?

events.title: Woodstock '69: 57 years on
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, becoming a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since Woodstock, the festival's spirit of peace and music lives on. Which iconic performance do you wish you'd seen live?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: King of Rock 'n' Roll Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago today, we lost the King. Elvis Presley's music continues to define generations. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since his passing, Tupac Shakur's influence on hip-hop and culture remains immense. His music still resonates today.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Iconic guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Guitar God
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago, we lost a true guitar legend. Jimi Hendrix's innovative playing continues to inspire. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles walked across that zebra crossing and gave us 'Abbey Road'. Which track is on repeat for you?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde's Voice
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude with The Pretenders are truly timeless.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad Fer It Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the legendary Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: The first iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Can you believe the first iPod is 25 today? From click wheels to tiny screens, it changed everything. What was your first iPod?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 'Dr. No' hit screens. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate theme tune?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Music icon John Lennon would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Imagine Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent of John Lennon. His music and message still resonate deeply.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is undeniable.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles gave us the iconic 'White Album'. So many classics, so much variety. What's your favourite track from it?
